tool_selection.what: pick the right function among the offered tools; correct name; simple arguments; one call
tool_selection.verifier_strength: G1 (WorkBench final state) or G2 (Pivot expected_action; Toucan target tools)

schema_arguments.what: one call whose arguments need nested objects, arrays, enums, numbers with units or optional fields; schema-valid JSON
schema_arguments.verifier_strength: G1 (WorkBench) or G2 (Pivot programmatic argument comparison), with JSON Schema validation always

no_tool.what: tools are offered but none is needed or none fits: answer directly without a call
no_tool.verifier_strength: B (no call), plus a gold answer where the task carries one

multiple_parallel.what: two or more calls in one assistant turn, same or different functions
multiple_parallel.verifier_strength: G1 for sequential multiple calls (WorkBench); parallel calls only G2 by tool names and replay agreement (Toucan): no legal source with gold parallel arguments

multi_turn.what: sequential calls across turns, reading tool results, follow-up reasoning and a final answer from the results; multi-user-turn conversations
multi_turn.verifier_strength: G1 (WorkBench multi-step) or G2 (Pivot per step; Toucan replay agreement)

error_recovery.what: a tool returns an error or fails, or a required parameter is missing: retry with corrected arguments, report the failure, or ask for the missing value
error_recovery.verifier_strength: G1, partial: tool errors raised by WorkBench code, recovery judged by final state; ask-for-the-missing-value has no admitted source

task_record.task_id: tc1- + sha256('<dataset>@<revision>|<upstream row key>|<variant>')[:20]: one id per task, the same for every teacher
task_record.source: dataset id, revision, split, upstream row key, the review's verdict
task_record.family: sha256 of the canonical tool-set signature (sorted function names with their canonical JSON schemas); an MCP task's family is its server id
task_record.tools: the function schemas as JSON Schema, canonicalized (keys sorted); never edited beyond canonical serialization
task_record.inputs: the non-assistant messages: system text a source carries, user turns and when scripted later user turns arrive
task_record.backend: kind replay | executable | none; replay: canonical call -> recorded response; executable: pinned code with no network run inside the episode loop (WorkBench's sandbox); never a live API, a network call or a tool simulated by an LLM at generation time; scripted errors by step
task_record.success: per step the gold call set (name + arguments, with allowed argument variants) and the order rule (G2), or the sandbox's final state against the ground truth (G1); the final check (none | no_call | contains_all | number | asks_for)
task_record.limits: max_turns; the rendered prompt length under each teacher's template
task_record.content_keys: sha256 of the normalized first user message and of the canonical tool set

splits.rule: by family, never by task: int(sha256('tool_pool@v1|' + family), 16) mod 100 -> 0-2 validation, 3-6 state_eval, 7-10 calibration, 11-12 reserve, 13-99 training, so no evaluation, calibration or state-evaluation task shares a tool family with a training task
splits.order: the training split's canonical order is a seeded shuffle (seed 20261103) frozen with its sha256 before any generation; every teacher walks the same order

task_pool.rendered_length: a task whose rendered first prompt exceeds 6,144 tokens under any of the three templates is left out of the pool for every teacher (recorded), so every turn keeps at least 2,040 tokens of generation allowance inside the 8,192-token training sequence; nothing is cut

lineages._: each teacher's official template and preset (generation_protocol.json; c1_identity_audit.json :: targets_teacher); the tools go to apply_chat_template(tools=...) and the template renders them; nothing is prefilled by hand

execution.runner: run_battery.run_episodes' episode loop: each turn's prompt is the official template's rendering of the conversation so far; the backend answers the turn's parsed calls with tool messages; the episode ends at a turn without a call, at max_turns, or at any non-EOS stop
execution.allowance: per turn 8,184 minus the rendered prompt; a turn that reaches it is length_limited and its episode refused whole, never cut
execution.seeds: request_seed(seed_base, task_id, turn), candidate pass k at seed_base + k, the same rule for every teacher, so a (task, candidate, turn) has one seed whatever the model
execution.candidates: 2: pass 1 only for a task whose first candidate fails verification (the current protocol)
execution.context_rendering: the next turn's prompt renders the parsed assistant turn (reasoning, content, tool_calls) through the template, as a deployed runtime does; whether that re-rendering reproduces the generated ids is recorded per turn and reported; only generated ids are ever supervised

verification.where: the dev box, pure Python, one verifier for every teacher, no teacher-specific leniency
verification.V1_protocol: natural termination, no degeneration stop; thinking modes close </think> before any call, non-thinking keeps the preclosed empty think; every <tool_call> block is JSON with name and arguments; nothing but whitespace after the last </tool_call>
verification.V2_schema: the name is an offered tool; the arguments validate against its JSON Schema (required, types, enums, nesting, no undeclared field where additionalProperties is false)
verification.V3_gold_calls: each step's call set equals the gold set (order-free for parallel calls) under the task's declared argument variants (G2); an executable task's final state equals its ground truth (G1)
verification.V4_execution: the backend answered every call: recorded or executed response, or the step's scripted error; an off-script call ends the episode (refused, counted per teacher)
verification.V5_task_success: the final turn makes no call and passes the task's final check (no_call; contains_all values from the tool results or the gold answer; number; asks_for the missing parameter)
verification.admission: an episode enters training whole only if V1-V5 pass on every turn; otherwise the task's next candidate, then nothing

protocol.supervision: only the teacher's own assistant output ids (kd_scope assistant: CE and KD positions); system text, tool schemas, user turns and tool responses are context with mask 0, never targets
protocol.never: another teacher's or mode's output ids, thinking traces, tool calls or reference logits; the upstream dataset's assistant turns; a re-rendered target
protocol.records: per turn: task_id, teacher id and revision, mode, template and tokenizer sha256, seed, prompt_token_ids, output_token_ids, raw text, parsed calls, backend responses, stop reason, think state, scored positions; per episode: every V-check verdict, admission, source, family, category; sealed shards with sha256 (the supplement's completion-shard route)
protocol.pairing_report: per category and source: tasks offered, admitted per lineage, the intersections (A1-6cat and C1-6cat; A1-6cat and A2-6cat; all three), refusals by check, family distribution and supervised-token deviation from the quota
